name: 芭蕾柔美 / Balletcore
scope: 低对比空气感、训练室空间与舒展构图。
distinctive_features: 低对比空气感、训练室空间与舒展构图。
与真实舞台服装或专业舞蹈动作区分；不拉长肢体制造纤细。
base_policy: 未选新组件时保留旧配方；明确用途/媒介/逐张计划替换冲突段，不能把本卡与旧pack重复累加。
input_requirements: 明确当前商品参考及不可改事实；仅展示有依据的视角。
人物来源与允许调整项沿用当前人物记录；不得把服装图中的人脸自动当作身份授权。
boundaries: 风格名是已定义摄影配方，不代表该国家全部审美或人物国籍。
适用品类/anti_categories是默认推荐线索；用户明确保留商品借用摄影时，按实际结构与适龄边界适配，不改成推荐服种。
当前修订未获得新实图验收，旧样片的接受只保留原范围。
garment_preservation: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。
planning_requirements: 场景列表给空间候选，不能由其顺序改变逐张动作。
单张/系列/独立比较/融合按本次意图，多个名称不自动混在一张图。

photography.scene: 练功房木地板与简洁墙面，保留舒缓空间感。
photography.lighting: 柔和自然光或已选大面积柔棚光，低对比、细腻过渡。
photography.composition: 舒展但不过度拉伸的空间比例，以留白和重复线条形成柔和节奏。 每张按已确认的逐张计划组织。
photography.palette: 环境采用粉白、雾灰或奶油色，商品保留实物色。 商品原色与饱和度保持不变。

prompt_fragment: 本卡审美意图：芭蕾启发的柔美编辑摄影：轻盈、节制、韵律感，优雅来自画面组织而非改造身体或商品。 摄影内容只使用本次解析后的 photography 字段；人物气质仅按当前人物条件处理，不另行拼接旧 pack 全文。

art.direction: 芭蕾启发的柔美编辑摄影：轻盈、节制、韵律感，优雅来自画面组织而非改造身体或商品。
limits: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。

negatives: 不新增商品参考中没有的服装部件、图案、首饰或品牌标识
不通过拉长身体、缩腰或改变人物年龄制造风格
不加入广告标题、价格、促销语、品牌口号或海报版式；商品原有文字标识保留
no invented stage-costume details beyond the reference garment
acceptance: 商品与人物事实分别对照原始参考，不能只拿上一次生成图互相核对。
独立成图满足本次画幅与逐张计划；联系表或预览不能替代独立图片。
风格差异来自所选视觉手段，不能以改变商品或身份换取差异。
与真实舞台服装或专业舞蹈动作区分；不拉长肢体制造纤细。
光线、色彩与场景的具体特征可在画面中判断；不以名字或形容词代替验收。

evidence.scope: 当前修订尚无实图验收；既有历史记录保留，不自动扩展其接受范围。

persona: graceful calm expression, gentle composure, poised softness
persona_guidance: 仅当本次人物条件允许调整时采用；已锁定的身份、年龄、妆发与表情优先。graceful calm expression, gentle composure, poised softness

commitments.show: soft, low-contrast airy light from large windows or a soft studio source with fine gradual transitions
commitments.check: very soft shadows; light feels airy; no hard spot, no stage spotlight

commitments.show: a practice studio: pale wooden floor, a plain barre, pale pink, mist-gray or cream walls, sheer window light; no stage, no theatre seats, no costumes
commitments.check: wooden floor and barre or plain walls present; no stage set or performance costume added

commitments.show: graceful posture: long neck, shoulders down, light upright carriage; arm and leg shapes soft, never stretched or acrobatic
commitments.check: posture lifted and calm; no split, no high leg, no exaggerated limb length

commitments.show: calm, gentle, graceful expression with a soft closed-lip smile or quiet focus
commitments.check: soft calm face; no sultry look, no broad grin

commitments.show: soft flushed makeup: luminous skin, rosy flush on the cheeks, a sheer glossy pink lip; hair as the identity reference, smooth
realize: no bun, ribbon or hair ornament added unless already in the identity reference
commitments.check: flush soft pink; lip sheer; no added bun or ribbon

action_tendency: Light, lifted and quiet: soft rounded arms, long neck, small poised steps around a practice studio, resting at the barre or on the floor; never acrobatic, sexualized or gym-athletic.

pose_vocabulary.body: standing beside a plain barre, body three-quarter, heels together with toes softly apart, posture lifted
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand resting lightly on the barre at hip height, the other arm soft and low
pose_vocabulary.check: barre at hip height beside the body; relaxed small foot shape, not a split or high leg

pose_vocabulary.body: standing in front of a studio mirror, body angled toward it, face turned back toward camera, neck long
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms soft and low at the sides
pose_vocabulary.check: garment front faces the lens, not only seen in the mirror; reflection does not double the figure confusingly

pose_vocabulary.body: sitting upright on a simple wooden stool at the edge of the studio, knees together, one foot resting lightly in front of the other, neck long
pose_vocabulary.hands: both hands resting on the stool edge beside the hips
pose_vocabulary.check: upright lifted seat; knees together; garment front fully visible

pose_vocabulary.body: sitting on a low studio bench, leaning slightly to one side toward the feet
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand adjusting the strap of a plain flat shoe at the ankle, the other on the bench
pose_vocabulary.avoid_when: garments whose front would fold heavily when leaning
pose_vocabulary.check: lean is small; garment front not hidden by the arm

pose_vocabulary.body: a light small step across the studio floor, heel to toe, posture lifted
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms soft and slightly open at the sides, wrists relaxed, never in front of the body
pose_vocabulary.check: arms beside the body; step light and small; not a bridal slow walk

pose_vocabulary.body: standing upright by a tall studio window with sheer curtains, weight on one leg, shoulders down
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms soft and relaxed at the sides
pose_vocabulary.check: soft window light on the figure; calm lifted posture

pose_vocabulary.body: walking lightly away from camera across the studio toward a bright window
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms soft and low at the sides
pose_vocabulary.check: back of the garment fully readable; light small step

pose_vocabulary.body: half-body, neck long, shoulders down and relaxed, chin slightly lifted
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms soft and low, out of frame
pose_vocabulary.check: neckline and shoulder details fully visible; no hand at the neckline
